hana: Quick microprobe request for launch comms  need a targeted 250-query run (smoke + small variance slice). Deliverables in 48h if possible.

omar: on it. list the exact artifact manifest and the success gates pls.

hana: artifact manifest: 1) per-request CSV (req_id, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_tag), 2) percentile table (p50/p90/p99) as CSV, 3) warm vs cold heatmap PNG, 4) small sample_manifest.csv (first 20 inputs), 5) runner_snippet.txt (redact keys), 6) short README with seed link + kernel/quant flags used. success gates: <1% errors, p99 within expected envelope.

maya: also include observed mean batch size and cache hit rate. for model tags use rw-large-v1:2026-03-10 baseline and try rw-large-v1-q4_0 for a single quantized trace. if quantized p99 regresses >15% mark as "do not use in headline".

greg: tagging runtimebot for scheduling: @runtimebot can you confirm staging slot and whether q4 kernels are present?

runtimebot: job scheduled id=jb_mkt_3167. est duration 2.5h on staging-gpu-2. q4 kernels present on staging; fallback to rw-medium may occur under contention. artifacts path: /artifacts/jb_mkt_3167/.

omar: i'll own packaging and the 1-slide summary + one-paragraph caveat. ETA 12h after artifacts land.

runtimebot: job jb_mkt_3167 completed (2h40m). artifacts: latency.csv, percentiles.csv, heatmap.png, sample_manifest.csv, runner_snippet_redacted.txt, README.txt. metrics: mean_batch=3.9, cache_rate=11%. quantized p99 = +11% vs baseline. no request failures.

hana: thanks all  marketing will feature baseline numbers and include a footnote about the quantized delta (+11%) with appendix detail for the webinar. closing the loop unless SRE asks for packaging changes. :thumbsup:
